originalTitle: No Man's Sky COSMOS Update Trailer
content: COSMOS: INTRODUCING UPDATE 7.0 Claim and personalise a space station, join an alliance, construct a space base and discover deep-space marvels in No Man's Sky Cosmos. Space exploration has been reinvented, with a new Star System Map to track the locations of points of interest. Strip colossal hulks for parts before hull integrity fails, recover and haul physical salvage to remote space outposts, or build a home out among the stars. Take command of a space station, and create or join an alliance to compete for the most expansive territory in the galaxy. Journey back through time in the Our Journey Continues expedition, celebrating 10 years of No Man's Sky. Full patch notes here: https://www.nomanssky.com/cosmos-update
